blocks.text: Computed tomography (CT scan) X-ray technology ko computer processing se jor kar andaruni banawaton ki zyada resolution wali cross-sectional aur 3D tasaveer banati hai. Yeh khaas taur par bimariyon ki tashkhees, andaruni choton ki pehchan aur ilaj ki rehnumai mein mufeed hai. Aam X-ray chapti (2D) tasveer deti hai jis mein haddiyan aur aza aik doosre par chadh jate hain; seene ki X-ray (Fig 20.7) mein agli aur pichhli pasliyan alag pehchanna mushkil hai kyunke aik doosre ke oopar nazar aati hain.

CT scanner jism ke aik hi hisse ki mukhtalif zawiyon se bohat si X-ray tasaveer leta hai: X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti jab ke detectors apni jagah rehte aur har taraf se maloomat jama karte hain (Fig 20.8). Computer in tasaveer ko jor kar tafseeli cross-sectional (qash, slice) tasveer banata hai. Phir scanner jism ke saath thora khisak kar agle qash ke liye amal dohrata hai, aur aakhir computer tamam qashon ko jor kar andaruni banawat ki 3D tasveer banata hai. Naam 'computed' (computer data process karta), 'tomography' (Greek tomos, yani qash) aur 'axial' (scan jism ke mehwar ke saath) se hai: computed axial tomography. Fig 20.9 CT scan karwate bachche ko dikhati hai, monitor par sar ka cross-section.

blocks.alt: Mareez couch par X-ray detectors ki ring ke andar leta hai. Ring ke neeche X-ray tube se X-ray shua mareez ki rasoli (tumour) se guzar kar oopar 'activated' X-ray detector tak jati hai. Labels: Patient on couch, Activated X-ray detector, X-ray detectors, X-ray, Tumour, X-ray tube.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.8: CT scanner ka amal (kitab ki Figure 20.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki shakal mein 'gamma ray' aur 'gamma ray detectors' likha hai aur ring ke dono taraf surkh detectors hain. CT mein gamma rays nahi, X-rays istemal hoti hain: aik taraf X-ray tube aur saamne detector hota hai, aur tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai. Isi liye hum ne 'X-ray', 'X-ray detectors' aur neeche 'X-ray tube' dikhaya hai.

blocks.title: Zyada tar jadeed CT scanners mein detectors bhi ghoomte hain
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke X-ray tube ghoomti hai 'jab ke detectors apni jagah rehte hain'. Yeh aik design (detectors ki muqarrara ring) ka bayan hai; zyada tar jadeed scanners mein detectors ki qaus tube ke saath mukhalif taraf ghoomti hai. Is ki Fig 20.8 par 'gamma ray detectors' aur 'gamma ray' bhi likha hai; CT mein shua X-rays hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: CT scanner Sir Godfrey Hounsfield (England) aur Allan Cormack (South Africa) ne 1970 ki dahai ke shuru mein ijad kiya; dono ko 1979 ka Physiology ya Medicine Nobel Prize mila. CT scans seconds mein saikron qash banate hain, jaise digital seb ko tah dar tah chheelna, aur falij (stroke) ko shuru hone ke minuton mein pakar sakte hain, jo jaan bachane wale ilaj ke liye bohat ahem hai.

CT scans riwayati X-rays par ahem faide dete hain. Aik X-ray tasveer jaldi banti aur ab bhi mufeed hai lekin sirf chapta, do-jehti manzar deti hai; CT teen-jehti tasaveer banata hai jo aza, haddiyon aur doosri banawaton ka size, shakal aur theek jagah dikhati hain, aur milti julti density wale tissues alag pehchanna aasan banati hain. Maslan CT scan rasoli ki jagah aur size saaf dikha sakta hai, jo doctors ko zyada tawanai ki X-rays ya gamma rays se use theek nishana banane mein madad deta hai. Lekin CT scans X-rays, yani ionising shua, use karte hain, is liye thora khatra hai. CT scan ki khurak scan ki qism par munhasir hai: sar ka CT taqreeban 2 mSv (qudrati background shua ke taqreeban 8 mahine) aur seene ya pet ka CT taqreeban 7-10 mSv (taqreeban 2-3 saal) deta hai. Is liye doctors khaas ehtiyat karte hain, khaas taur par hamila khawateen ya pehle se bimar mareezon ke scan mein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke CT scan ki ausat khurak saal bhar ki qudrati background shua ki aik tihai, ya chaar lambi hawai parwazon ke barabar hai. Asal khurak kahin zyada hai: sar ka CT taqreeban 2 mSv aur seene ya pet ka 7-10 mSv, jab ke saal bhar ki background taqreeban 2.4-3 mSv aur aik lambi parwaz sirf 0.03-0.1 mSv deti hai. Kitab ke dono muqable aapas mein bhi nahi milte. Isi liye CT sirf tab use hota hai jab us ka faida thore khatre se zyada ho.

blocks.prompt: CT scan aam X-ray mein chhupi rasoli kaise dikha sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Aam X-ray har raaste par har cheez ki jazbiyat jor deti hai, is liye banawatein aik doosre par chadh jati hain; CT qash ko bohat se zawiyon se napta aur computer qash ke har nuqte ki jazbiyat dobara banata hai, jis se oopar neeche ki banawatein aur density ke chhote farq alag ho jate hain.

items: CT: X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti; computer 2D qash bana kar 3D mein jorta.
Faide: 3D manzar, chadhi banawatein alag, rasoli ki jagah.
Ionising X-rays: thora khatra; hamila mareezon ke liye ehtiyat.
